user.title: Sign in to SomToday
user.description:
**Step 1.** Open this link and sign in — SSO and MFA are supported:

{auth_url}

**Step 2.** After signing in, the browser is sent to a `somtoday://…` address. On a device with the SomToday app installed (e.g. macOS or iOS) that link may open the app instead of showing the address in the address bar.

- If you can see the address, copy it.
- If the app opens instead, use DevTools (F12) → Network, click the request to `somtoday.nl`, and copy the `Location:` response header — it contains the code.

**Step 3.** Paste it below — the full URL, the `Location:` value, or just the code.

data_description.student_select: One config entry is created per student.

error.invalid_url: Could not find an authorization code in the pasted text.
error.login_page: It looks like the login was not completed yet. Finish logging in and paste the redirect URL.
error.state_mismatch: This redirect does not belong to the current login attempt. Please start again from the link above.
error.sso_callback: That is the Microsoft/SSO callback, not the final SomToday redirect. Keep going until the browser tries to open somtoday://… and use that location.
error.invalid_auth: SomToday rejected the authorization code. It may have expired or already been used — start again and paste the redirect right after logging in.
error.no_students: No students were found for this account.
error.wrong_account: A different SomToday account signed in.
